newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia pesos dips, ends lower against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Colombia pesos dips, ends lower against dollar.

text.p: Colombia's peso dipped 0.75 peso to close at 1,106.1 against the dollar in seesaw trade Friday, interbank dealers said.
"The peso rate rose early in the day as earnings from coal exports entered the market, but dropped back later as banks with short dollar positions moved to buy greenbacks," one trader said.
He said there were some petro-dollars in the market and some demand from the information technology sector.
Dealers reported 275 trades worth a total $144 million. The peso opened at 1,106 and rose to an intraday high of 1,104.8 and a low of 1,107.6.
